moments.title: Fiscal fairness reform evidence review
moments.success_looks_like: A credible reform package links fiscal sustainability with housing, tax-base, or youth opportunity measures under one generational-fairness frame.
moments.failure_looks_like: Reforms remain isolated, easily reversed, or framed only as deficit management without youth or future-generation distribution tests.
moments.preferred_future: Fairness between present and future generations
